name: Vanilla Matcha Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 65 mg of caffeine per can, printed on the band above the nutrition panel; it comes from matcha green tea, not coffee
summary: Matcha, not coffee: single-origin matcha green tea on whole milk made lactose-free, sold under La Colombe’s Coffee Workshop name rather than as a Draft Latte. A label-printed 65 mg of caffeine per 11 oz can, all of it from the tea, at 160 calories with 16 g of sugar (7 g of it added), 7 g of protein and 3 g of fiber. The neck band calls it Vanilla Matcha Latte; the front reads Matcha Latte, Vanilla.
